name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free app that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into narrated audiobooks, all running on your own computer with no cloud subscription.
buyer: A YouTuber, course creator, or audiobook narrator who currently pays monthly for ElevenLabs-style voice tools and wants the same capability for free, with full control over their own voice.
business_use_cases: A YouTuber dubs their English videos into 5 languages overnight to reach new audiences, without paying a translation and voiceover studio.
A course creator narrates an entire written course into audio in their own cloned voice in an afternoon, instead of booking recording sessions.
An indie audiobook producer offers cheap narration services to self-published authors by running batch audiobook jobs locally instead of paying per-minute cloud fees.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'video localization' service for YouTubers and course creators: dub their back catalog into several languages for a flat fee per video.
Run a niche audiobook narration service for self-published authors who can't afford professional studio narration.

steal_this: Pick one of your own videos, dub it into two other languages with this tool this weekend, and pitch the service to a few small YouTube creators.
